tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare a consolidated packet for Paper Otter Legal by 2024-04-12 using the trust, wills, powers of attorney, account titling notes, and beneficiary observations.

tickets.text: Obtain beneficiary paperwork for Julian’s traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to confirm Elena as primary beneficiary and Samira and Theo as equal contingent beneficiaries per stirpes.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the traditional IRA beneficiary paperwork by 2024-04-10.

tickets.title: Follow up on retirement plan beneficiary inconsistency
tickets.text: Follow up on the inconsistency between the Pocket Lantern Systems retirement plan portal, which lists the Thimble Harbor Revocable Trust as primary beneficiary, and Julian’s estate worksheet, which indicates Elena should be primary on retirement assets.

tickets.title: Confirm taxable account title and transfer-on-death options
tickets.text: Confirm the intended title for Julian and Elena’s joint taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody and the available transfer-on-death options. Reconcile the joint tenancy label on the latest statement with the trust account description in the estate inventory.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to confirm the intended title and available transfer-on-death options by 2024-04-18.

tickets.title: Follow up on account security item
tickets.text: Review the reported account security concern, confirm the client’s preferred secure communication method, verify whether access credentials, multi-factor authentication, trusted contacts, or recent account activity require attention, and document the resolution steps. Do not request or record passwords or authentication codes. Elena could not open the shared vault invitation during the meeting because the authentication prompt failed. Review vault access, trusted contacts, and secure delivery preferences.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to review vault access, trusted contacts, and secure delivery preferences by 2024-04-08, without collecting passwords or codes.

tickets.title: Complete pre-consult estate questionnaire for Paper Otter Legal
tickets.text: Complete the pre-consult estate questionnaire for Paper Otter Legal before the scheduled attorney discussion. Include household members, asset categories, fiduciary candidates, and client-stated priorities.
tickets.evidence: they agreed to complete the pre-consult estate questionnaire for Paper Otter Legal by 2024-04-16 before the scheduled attorney discussion

tickets.title: Concentrated Holding Snapshot
tickets.text: Prepare a current snapshot of the Pocket Lantern Systems stock exposure, unrealized gain, vesting schedule, and liquidity implications within Julian and Elena Mossbutton’s broader estate picture. The stock represents about 18% of their investable assets.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare a current snapshot of the Pocket Lantern Systems stock exposure, unrealized gain, vesting schedule, and liquidity implications by 2024-04-19.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Develop a retirement income plan using Julian and Elena Mossbutton’s stated retirement timing, spending goals, guaranteed income sources, portfolio resources, tax considerations, and liquidity needs. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare a clear recommendation summary for review. Pair the estate update with a retirement income roadmap reflecting Julian’s planned work transition, Elena’s expected pension, Social Security timing, cash reserves, and anticipated portfolio withdrawals.

subTasks.title: Gather retirement income inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates, anticipated retirement date or phase-in plan, Social Security or pension information, expected withdrawals, cash reserves, and known large upcoming expenses.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and income scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare base, conservative, and flexible withdrawal scenarios. Note sequence-of-return risk, inflation assumptions, tax-sensitive account sequencing, and any years with unusual income or deductions.

subTasks.title: Identify tax-aware implementation steps
subTasks.text: Review opportunities for Roth conversions, capital gain harvesting, charitable giving strategies, estimated tax payments, and coordination with the client's CPA where appropriate.

subTasks.title: Prepare client review summary
subTasks.text: Summarize recommended income sources, withdrawal order, cash reserve target, key risks, open questions, and follow-up actions for the client meeting.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that roadmap by 2024-04-26.

tickets.title: Obtain life insurance policy confirmations
tickets.text: Obtain current ownership and beneficiary confirmation pages for Julian and Elena Mossbutton’s Silver Marmot Insurance term policies for the estate review. The Apricot Compass file does not include these pages.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to obtain current policy confirmations for the estate review by 2024-04-17.

tickets.title: Send estate tax coordination note to Nadine Copperwisp
tickets.text: Send Nadine Copperwisp at Lavender Sprocket Tax a planning note covering the anticipated estate revisions, charitable giving pattern, concentrated stock exposure, and potential taxable gains before her tax projection meeting with Julian and Elena.
tickets.evidence: they agreed to send Nadine Copperwisp a planning note by 2024-04-24 covering the anticipated estate revisions, charitable giving pattern, concentrated stock exposure, and potential taxable gains before her tax projection meeting with Julian and Elena.
